name: good_fortune_unicorn_counter_on_each_returned_creature
notes: M5 mapper. Printed: 'Whenever another creature you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on that creature.' Seat 0 casts Raise the Past: Savannah Lions and Bear Cub (both mana value 2 or less) return from the graveyard at once; each trigger puts its counter on its own creature (Lions 3/2, Bear Cub 3/3), none on the Unicorn.
